::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Microchip has operated in India for 25 years. In 2025, it announced a $300 million investment to expand its India operations, including a new Bengaluru facility that can accommodate 3,000+ employees. India supports design for MCUs, FPGAs, networking, and security products.
:::

## What does this firm design?

8/16/32-bit microcontrollers, microprocessors, FPGA development, networking and data centre solutions, security and authentication products, wired and wireless connectivity solutions.
